column1: # Perl corpus: pipes. Format and regeneration: crates/builtins/src/perl/tests.rs.

column2: open my $f,'-|','sh','-c','echo ok; exit 5' or die $!; print scalar <$f>; print close($f)?1:0,'|',$?>>8,"\n";
open my $f,'-|','echo','hello' or die $!; print scalar <$f>; print close($f)?1:0,"|$?\n";
open my $f,'-|',q{printf 'yes\n' | cat} or die $!; print scalar <$f>; close $f;
open my $f,'echo hello |' or die $!; print scalar <$f>; close $f;
open my $f,'| cat' or die $!; print {$f} "written\n"; close $f or die $!;
open my $f,'|-','cat' or die $!; print {$f} "written\n"; close $f or die $!;

local $SIG{PIPE}="IGNORE"; pipe(my $r,my $w) or die; close $r; print defined(syswrite $w,"x") ? "wrote
" : "syswrite: $!

" : "close: $!
